metadata.response_text_not_published: response_full and response_preview held free model output (450 prose values, up to 2,717 characters). They are not committed: text that cannot be reviewed line by line does not enter this public repository. Each row keeps response_sha256 and response_chars, so a re-run can be checked against it text by text.

harness_block_label.why: the harness decided was_blocked by matching refusal phrasing, so a full answer that contained the phrasing was marked blocked. e9_analysis.json separated those rows afterwards by reading response_full. This field carries that separation as data, so e9_analysis.json is recomputable from the committed file.
harness_block_label.rule: a blocked row whose response_sha256 equals canned_refusal.sha256 is a true block; any other blocked row carries a generated answer and is a mislabel. Every label below is re-derivable from response_sha256 alone.

canned_refusal.text: I'm sorry, I can't respond to that.

source_file_before_this_transform.note: the file as the E9 harness wrote it, with response_full and response_preview present. Kept locally, outside version control.
